name: Bayesian Model Discrepancy Calibration
summary: Calibrate simulator parameters while explicitly modeling structural discrepancy between the physical simulator and observations.
summary_zh: 在校准物理参数时显式引入模型失配项，避免把所有观测偏差都解释成参数误差。
core_idea: Jointly infer uncertain simulator parameters and a statistical discrepancy function with an observation likelihood.
innovation: Accounts for structural misspecification rather than forcing parameters to absorb all systematic measurement mismatch.
limitations: Parameter and discrepancy contributions can be weakly identifiable.
Prior choices and limited observations can dominate predictions.

start_here.why: Classic model-calibration framework incorporating simulator bias.
start_here.focus: Parameter calibration, discrepancy process and prediction uncertainty.

curation_note: Authoritative journal source checked; the proposed starting reference is optional.
